title: Jagged Crispy Spanish Mozzarella Tart
description: A buttery, crispy tarta de Santiago-style tart packed with melty mozzarella and a shattering crust, made in one pot on a tava-griddle.
instructions: In a bowl, combine flour and salt.
Dissolve yeast in warm water, then add to the flour mixture along with olive oil; stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Transfer the dough to a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let it rise at room temperature for 4 hours until it doubles in size.
Preheat a tava-griddle over medium heat; lightly oil it to prevent sticking.
Punch down the risen dough, roll it out into a 10-inch circle, and place it onto the heated griddle, cooking until the bottom is golden and the edges start to pull away, about 6 minutes.
Flip the dough, spread shredded mozzarella evenly over the top, sprinkle oregano and paprika, then cook for an additional 4 minutes until the cheese melts and the crust cracks into jagged edges.
Remove the tart from the griddle, let it rest for 2 minutes, slice, and serve hot.
